notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence medium): Benilla's ui_gamma exists because Bevy composites in linear: it decodes the gamma-composited UI target once and vendors gamma copies of the Bevy-UI shaders. MSUI's ImGui UI pass draws directly into the presentation framebuffer, which already holds gamma bytes - FfxGlow.cs documents MSUI's scene/post targets as the same gamma-byte lane with a direct gamma write at present - so tints and blends are byte arithmetic like the reference with no decode node needed.

notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGE FINDING: The one behavioral consequence worth watching is additive-blend UI highlights (alphaMode=ADD gossip/quest row lift, GlueAdditive): MSUI's architecture composites those in gamma by construction, which is the reference posture; no per-site audit was done here.
